name: 旧婴儿车货篮
prompt: Create exactly ONE transparent game prop sprite. References 1/2 are fixed style: strong dark hand-drawn contours, broad painted light and shade masses, readable forms with some brush texture; do NOT copy their pedestal. Reference 3 and 5 are approved final furniture style and localized wear. Reference 4 is the floor projection: orthographic, camera elevation45°, ground axes +/-0.7071, vertical edges vertical, tile144x101.82. Plan ground footprint BEFORE illustration; bottom contact corners must follow the template. Small top-down 3/4 view, two clear faces. Full object, generous transparent margins, NO floor/platform/pedestal/text/cast shadow. Upper-left light, restrained worn teal/ochre/cream/charcoal palette, modern industrial salvage society with repair/reuse, not medieval treasure nor nuclear wasteland. Readable at actual 144px grid scale, shape detail not photographic noise. Old baby pram frame repurposed as cargo basket: worn cream cloth sling, dark gray tubular handle, four small wheels, two wrapped parcels and one tied cloth sack, NO baby, no dolls. Ground .75x.6tile, height42px at tile144. Cloth patches and one replaced wheel, broad shapes, full unsearched. Outside silhouette must be fully transparent: no halo, glow, smoky backdrop or drop shadow. Keep large areas of original color; wear only around use points, not everywhere.
